audience: award, grant and scholarship programs that review applications in OpenWater

useCases.title: Track the applications of one program
useCases.text: List the programs to find a program ID, then list the applications, filtered by time, to see recent submissions.

useCases.title: Read the scores of one application
useCases.text: List the judge evaluations of an application, with scores and notes. Then read the application to see its round status.

useCases.title: List the sessions of a session chair
useCases.text: List the sessions of a program, filtered by session chair, to see which panels each chair runs.

useCases.title: Review the funds of the organization
useCases.text: List the grant and award budgets of the organization to review them.

useCases.title: Add an applicant without sending e-mail
useCases.text: Create a user for an applicant. No e-mail is sent unless suppress_emails is set to false. Update the name or e-mail address later if needed.
